messages.subject: 4D-Modeller Hackathon, Nov 2-3, Oslo
parts:
Hello,

Hopefully its okay to post here about this, we are organizing a hackathon November 2-3 in Oslo for our package 4d-Modeller. This package is built on top of INLA and inlabru and is designed to make using the package easier for a wider audience. This includes shiny apps for building finite element meshes, an equation builder, and a map making tool for visualizing data. We would very much enjoy having participants join who have INLA/inlabru experience. There will be some amount of money for travel reimbursements for people coming from outside of Oslo.

Check out the preliminary schedule and more background on our website (https://4dmodeller.github.io/4DM_Hackathon/). And of course, sign up as soon as possible https://4dmodeller.github.io/4DM_Hackathon/_pages/register.html

Best,
--
John M. Aiken, PhD
Consultant, Expert Analytics
Researcher, The Njord Centre, University of Oslo
